rules.linear: every atom within 0.05 Å RMS of one line through the row's own atoms (≥ 2 atoms)
rules.planar: not linear, ≥ 3 atoms, every atom (H too) within 0.10 Å RMS of one plane through the row's own atoms
rules.strained: a ring of 3 or 4 atoms (RDKit SSSR)
rules.macrocycle: a ring of 12 atoms or more (RDKit SSSR)
rules.fused: two SSSR rings that share exactly one bond (two atoms)
rules.organometallic: a metal (METALS) bonded to carbon in the row's own atoms (DetermineConnectivity)
rules.zwitterion: net charge 0 with a formal + and a formal − on its atoms, a nitro group's N⁺/O⁻ not counted
rules.chiral: a stereocentre the SMILES marks (@ / @@), FindMolChiralCenters without the unassigned

extraWords (wait for Josh).cage: a polyhedral framework in which atoms form several faces (cubane, adamantane, C60); proposed for browsing, not used in rows
